subject: Television & Streaming
title: Streaming Consolidation
description: A fast breakdown of Streaming Consolidation for builders.

hook.text: Too many streaming services launched, too few made money. The age of consolidation has arrived.

buildup.text: Paramount+ merged with Showtime. Discovery and HBO combined into Max. Hulu was absorbed into Disney+.

discovery.text: The math is simple: most platforms lose money. Only a few can survive as standalone services.

twist.text: Analysts predict the market will settle into three or four dominant platforms—eerily similar to the old network model.

climax.text: Streaming disrupted television, then slowly rebuilt the same oligopoly it replaced. History rhymes.

punchline.text: Disruption ended where it started: a few giants in control.

quiz.question: What is streaming consolidation?
options: Adding more content to each platform
Merging smaller platforms into a few dominant services
